title: ZSDK ranges and limitations per organization

checks.do: Whether a design needs more than 48 App Connector groups behind one access policy rule, which the limit forbids even with all groups selected.
Whether a domain resolves to more than 200 addresses, or has more than 100 TXT records, on the App Connector.

per-organization.statement: ZSDK limits apply per organization unless noted otherwise, and an organization that needs a higher maximum asks Zscaler Support.

quotes: All values are per organization unless noted otherwise.
If you need to increase the maximum limit for your organization, send a request to Zscaler Support.

administration.statement: An organization can have 1,000 admins and 100 roles, and an admin user password can be 100 characters.

app-connectors.statement: An organization can have 100 App Connectors, 100 App Connector groups and 100 App Connector provisioning keys.

applications.statement: An organization can have 6,000 applications, with 2,000 per application segment counting IP addresses, domains and wildcards alike (every entry counts as one), and 4,000 Source IP Anchoring-enabled domains or IP addresses; 6,000 application segments, 240 of them Source IP Anchoring-enabled; 200 segment groups; 50 DNS suffixes; 10,000 servers; and 1,000 server groups.

quotes: The 2,000 applications per application segment limit applies to both IP addresses and domains. Wildcards also fall in the same category (i.e., every entry for the application in the ZSDK Admin Portal counts as one).
4,000 Source IP Anchoring-enabled domains or IP addresses
| Application Segments | 6,000 segments240 Source IP Anchoring-enabled segments |

dns.statement: DNS resolution on the App Connector resolves a single domain to no more than 200 IP addresses, and the ZSDK cloud handles up to 100 TXT records for a domain it looks up; beyond 100 the TXT records are ignored.

quotes: DNS resolution can resolve a single domain (such as example.com or host.example.com) to no more than 200 IP addresses on the App Connector.
The ZSDK cloud can only handle up to 100 TXT records for any domain that it looks up. The DNS TXT records are ignored if the lookup surpasses 100 DNS TXT records.

authentication-certificates.statement: An organization can have 10 IdP configurations, 100 SAML attributes, 1,000 web server certificates and 1,000 enrollment certificates.

access-policy.statement: Access policy allows 2,000 policy rules, 1,000 application segments per rule and 48 App Connector groups per rule; the 48-group limit applies even when all App Connector groups for the application are selected.

quotes: 2,000 policy rules1,000 application segments per policy rule48 App Connector groups per policy ruleThe 48 App Connector groups per policy rule limit applies even if All App Connector groups for the application is selected when configuring an access policy rule.

device-profiles.statement: An organization can have 200 device profiles, with 50 UUIDs per profile and 10 of each other attribute per profile.

quotes: 200 device profiles50 UUIDs per device profile10 for all other attributes per profile

private-service-edges.statement: An organization can have 100 ZSDK Private Service Edges, 100 Private Service Edge groups and 100 Private Service Edge provisioning keys.

quotes: | Private Service Edges | 100 Private Service Edges |
| Private Service Edge Provisioning Keys | 100 keys |
